row: 小琉球（琉球嶼）位於臺灣本島西南約13公里，是屏東縣的珊瑚礁島嶼，滿潮面積約6.8平方公里。島上有1736年建的碧雲寺、花瓶岩、美人洞與烏鬼洞，夏天綠蠵龜會在中澳沙灘產卵。

tagline.zh-Hant: 船難、悲劇與廟宇撐起的漁島
tagline.en: Shipwrecks, a tragedy, and a fishing island held together by temples

zh: 小琉球在臺灣本島西南約13公里，
是屏東縣的一個鄉。
en: Xiaoliuqiu lies about 13 km south-west of Taiwan's main island,
a township of Pingtung County.

zh: 「琉球嶼」這個名稱，明代就已出現；
歐洲人曾稱它 Lambay 或 Lamay。
en: The name Liuqiu was already in use under the Ming;
Europeans called it Lambay or Lamay.

zh: 一般認為，西拉雅族是島上最早的住民。
en: The Siraya are thought to have been the first inhabitants.

zh: 1622年，荷蘭船「金獅號」在礁石上擱淺，
船員遭島民殺害。
en: In 1622 the Dutch ship Gouden Leeuw ran onto the reefs
and its crew was killed by islanders.

zh: 荷蘭人因此稱它「金獅島」；
1631年，又有一艘荷蘭船在此遇難。
en: The Dutch named it Golden Lion Island after the ship;
in 1631 another Dutch vessel was wrecked here.

zh: 1636年，荷蘭遠征隊把居民困在洞穴中，煙燻八天；
約300人死亡，323人被擄為奴。
en: In 1636 a Dutch expedition trapped the islanders in a cave and smoked it for eight days;
about 300 died and 323 were enslaved.

zh: 烏鬼洞，是島上最重要的洞穴之一。
en: Black Dwarf Cave is one of the island's most important caves.

zh: 1645年，最後13位原住民
被一位漢人商人帶離。
en: In 1645 a Chinese merchant removed
the last thirteen of the original islanders.

zh: 最早來定居的漢人，一說是福建的陳姓漁民，
一說是1662年以後到來的李月老。
en: The first Han settler is said to be a Fujian fisherman surnamed Chen,
or Li Yuelao, who came after 1662.

zh: 碧雲寺建於1736年，主祀觀音，
至今仍是居民的信仰中心。
en: Biyun Temple, built in 1736, is dedicated to Guanyin
and is still the centre of island faith.

zh: 1895年清朝統治結束時，
島上約有200位居民。
en: When Qing rule ended in 1895
about 200 people lived on the island.

zh: 日治時期屬高雄州；
戰後成為屏東縣琉球鄉。
en: Under Japanese rule it belonged to Takao Prefecture;
after 1945 it became Liuqiu Township of Pingtung County.

zh: 2004年納入大鵬灣國家風景區後，觀光快速成長；
2012年遊客超過50萬人次。
en: After joining the Dapeng Bay National Scenic Area in 2004 tourism grew fast;
in 2012 it received over 500,000 visitors.

zh: 船難、悲劇與信仰，
都寫在這座小島上。
en: Shipwrecks, a tragedy and faith
are all written into this small island.

title.en: Guanyin, the Lords and the Fishermen

zh: 碧雲寺位在島的中心，
主祀觀音菩薩。
en: Biyun Temple stands at the centre of the island,
dedicated to Guanyin.

zh: 婚喪擇日、彌月、求姻緣，到祈求漁船滿載，
居民的生活都與觀音分不開。
en: Weddings, funerals, a baby's first month, a good match, a full catch:
island life is bound up with Guanyin.

zh: 這座小島上至少有38座主要廟宇，
加起來多達70座。
en: This small island has at least 38 main temples,
as many as 70 in all.

zh: 三隆宮俗稱王爺廟，
供奉朱、池、吳三府千歲。
en: Sanlong Temple, the Wangye temple,
honours the three Lords Zhu, Chi and Wu.

zh: 相傳有人帶著三位王爺乘小船來到島上，
搭起一間草廟，就是三隆宮的開始。
en: Legend says the three Lords were carried here on a small boat
and housed in a grass hut: the start of Sanlong Temple.

zh: 在黑潮裡捕魚，
長久以來是島上的經濟支柱；箱網養殖也很重要。
en: Fishing in the Kuroshio has long been the mainstay;
cage aquaculture matters too.

zh: 海景休閒度假區展出老照片，
介紹傳統漁法與漁具。
en: The Seaview Leisure Area shows old photographs
and the island's traditional fishing gear and methods.

zh: 白沙觀光港是旅客進出的主要港口，
有環島船與半潛艇。
en: Baisha Harbour is the main way in for visitors,
with round-island boats and a semi-submarine.

zh: 琉行之道全長約1,440公尺，
串起樹林與海景，沿途有藝術作品。
en: The Liuxing Trail runs about 1,440 m,
linking woods and sea views, with art works along the way.

zh: 山豬溝有個傳說：山豬精偷走仙女的彩衣，
仙女取回衣服離去，山豬精羞憤而死。
en: A legend names Shanzhugou: a boar spirit stole a fairy's robe;
she won it back and left, and the boar died of shame.

zh: 多仔坪的潮間帶，
退潮時是島上的生態教室。
en: The Duozaiping reef flat
becomes a nature classroom at low tide.

zh: 每個月有幾天，退潮落在夜裡，
人們打著手電筒去探索。
en: A few days each month low tide falls at night,
and people explore by torchlight.

zh: 靈山寺前的花瓶岩，
是船隻往返的地標，被稱為「小琉球守護神」。
en: Vase Rock, in front of Lingshan Temple,
is a landmark for boats, the guardian of the island.

zh: 觀音、王爺與海，
是小琉球人生活的中心。
en: Guanyin, the Lords and the sea
are at the centre of island life.

tagline.zh-Hant: 珊瑚礁、潮間帶與一百多種魚
tagline.en: Coral reef, tide pools and more than a hundred kinds of fish

zh: 小琉球是一座珊瑚礁島，
海岸多半是珊瑚礁岩。
en: Xiaoliuqiu is a coral island;
most of its coast is reef rock.

zh: 中澳沙灘附近記錄到約176種魚；
夏天，成年綠蠵龜會上岸產卵。
en: About 176 fish species live near Zhong'ao Beach;
in summer adult green sea turtles come ashore to nest.

zh: 這裡的潮間帶與亞潮帶，
由珊瑚礁與貝殼碎屑堆積而成。
en: The intertidal and shallow zones here
are built of coral and shell debris.

zh: 多仔坪的潮間帶，退潮時露出整片礁岩平臺。
en: At Duozaiping low tide uncovers a whole platform of reef.

zh: 白天、夜晚都有不同的生物出現，
是島上受歡迎的生態觀察地。
en: Different creatures appear by day and by night;
it is a favourite place to watch wildlife.

zh: 黑潮從附近流過，
帶來豐富的漁場。
en: The Kuroshio runs close by
and makes for rich fishing grounds.

zh: 美人洞一帶由珊瑚礁岩構成，奇石錯落。
en: The Beauty Cave area is made of coral rock, scattered with odd-shaped stones.

zh: 厚石裙礁一帶怪石特別多，
有些巨石頂端長著茂密的枝葉。
en: Around Houshi the reef is crowded with strange rocks,
some crowned with thick leafy growth.

zh: 其中一塊巨石，遠看像一顆人頭的側影。
en: One boulder looks from afar like a head in profile.

zh: 蛤板灣的白色沙灘，
滿是細緻的貝殼砂。
en: Geban Bay's white beach
is made of fine shell sand.

zh: 花瓶岩頭大身小，
底部被海水侵蝕得特別細。
en: Vase Rock is big at the top and narrow at the base,
where the sea has worn it thin.

zh: 島的南側，海面一片深藍。
en: On the south side the sea turns deep blue.

zh: 沿著海岸步道，
樹林與海景交替出現。
en: Along the coastal path
woods and sea views take turns.

zh: 珊瑚、潮間帶與海龜，
讓這座小島成為海的教室。
en: Coral, tide pools and turtles
make this small island a classroom of the sea.

title.en: A Reef Raised from the Sea

tagline.zh-Hant: 花瓶岩、海蝕洞與島上的燈塔
tagline.en: Vase Rock, sea caves and the island's lighthouse

zh: 小琉球是臺灣最大的珊瑚礁島嶼之一，
也是唯一有大量居民的一座。
en: Xiaoliuqiu is one of Taiwan's largest coral islands,
and the only one with a sizeable population.

zh: 滿潮時面積約6.8平方公里，
南北約4公里，東西約2公里。
en: At high tide it covers about 6.8 square kilometres,
some 4 km north to south and 2 km east to west.

zh: 它在東港南南西方約15公里的海上，
位在臺灣海峽。
en: It lies about 15 km south-south-west of Donggang,
in the Taiwan Strait.

zh: 花瓶岩高約9公尺，
是珊瑚礁隨地殼隆起而抬升出海面的。
en: Vase Rock is about 9 metres tall,
coral reef lifted above the sea as the crust rose.

zh: 之後長期受海水侵蝕，
形成頭大身小的奇特模樣。
en: Long erosion by the sea then gave it
its odd top-heavy shape.

zh: 島的沿岸主要是侵蝕性的珊瑚礁海岸，
沙岸只有幾處。
en: The shore is mostly eroding coral reef,
with only a few sandy beaches.

zh: 其中規模最大的沙岸，就是蛤板灣。
en: The largest of them is Geban Bay.

zh: 島上最重要的洞穴有三處：
烏鬼洞、美人洞與龍蝦洞。
en: The island's most important caves are three:
Black Dwarf Cave, Beauty Cave and Lobster Cave.

zh: 美人洞背山面海，
礁岩洞穴渾然天成。
en: Beauty Cave has the hill behind and the sea in front,
its reef caves shaped by nature.

zh: 白燈塔建於1929年，基座到塔頂約10公尺，
燈光離海面約88公尺。
en: The White Lighthouse was built in 1929, about 10 m from base to top,
its light some 88 m above the sea.

zh: 它和墾丁的鵝鑾鼻燈塔一樣，
為往返的漁船指引方向。
en: Like Eluanbi Lighthouse in Kenting,
it guides the fishing boats coming and going.

zh: 南端的厚石裙礁，
是一片布滿礁岩的海岸。
en: At the southern end the Houshi fringing reef
is a shore strewn with reef rock.

zh: 西南岸的烏鬼洞，
藏在珊瑚礁岩之間。
en: On the south-west shore Black Dwarf Cave
hides among the coral rocks.

zh: 珊瑚礁被抬出海面，
再被海浪雕成今天的小琉球。
en: Coral reef raised from the sea
and carved by the waves became today's Xiaoliuqiu.
